Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Savitri - 62 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Kunal - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi, Savitri and Kunal stand near him.]

Savitri: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil points at the sky.]

Nikhil: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nikhil nods.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

[Nikhil shakes his head.]

Nikhil: "Kunal, listen!"

[Nikhil whispers something to Mother.]

Meenakshi: "That's easy."

[Nikhil shouts angrily.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Mom, look at this."

[Nikhil takes the bag from Mother.]

Savitri: "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Savitri: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil eats his breakfast at the table.]

Meenakshi: "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil drinks a glass of water.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, of course."

[Nikhil sips hot tea from a cup.]

Nikhil (laughing): "That was fun!"

[Nikhil gulps down a glass of milk.]

Nikhil: "I really enjoyed today."
